source: Commons photos 10, 21; OSM had 7 m retail

set.notes: ASU Brickyard: 5-storey red-orange brick with cream stone banding and cornice, arched top-floor windows, blue-tinted glass in dark frames; charcoal metal awnings on cable stays over ground-floor shops on Mill; tall vertical maroon banners with gold lettering reading 'Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering' hung between the upper arched windows on the Mill Ave face, a large white 'ASU' sign high on the brick, and a Bank of America sign on the blue steel ground-floor canopy; small upper balconies; flat roof with mechanical units.

West 6th towers: teal/blue-green tinted glass curtain wall with pale cream horizontal spandrel bands and stacked balconies, flat crown with parapet and rooftop units; sits on a multi-level parking podium with ground-floor retail and palms at the Mill & 6th corner. (Second shorter tower, 22 floors, belongs beside it.) 'WEST 6TH' sign on the podium at the Mill & 6th corner.

Tempe Mission Palms hotel: 4 storeys of warm cream stucco in Spanish Mission style, arched openings, terracotta tile accents and parapets, a central courtyard with pool and tall palms, porte-cochere entry; flat roofs with mechanical units. 'Tempe Mission Palms' sign in bronze letters on the entry tower.
Hayden Square: a cluster of octagonal 3-4 storey stucco condominium towers in tan and terracotta tones with flat roofs and small balconies, set in paved courtyards with palms and shade trees.

Emerson Mill Avenue: modern 6-storey apartment block, mix of red brick and light grey/white panel facades, regular window grid, recessed balconies, rooftop units, ground-floor leasing office and retail glass along Mill.
Sonesta Select hotel: 3-storey light stucco hotel with regular window rows, surface parking with palms. 'Sonesta' sign at the entrance canopy.
Vib hotel: modern 4-storey hotel with grey and white panels and bright yellow accents, large ground-floor glazing. 'Vib' sign in yellow letters at the roofline.
Tempe Fire Station 6: low tan masonry fire station with red apparatus-bay doors and a small tower. 'Tempe Fire Station 6' lettering over the bay doors.
US Post Office: small single-storey tan masonry building with 'United States Post Office' lettering and a blue USPS eagle sign over the entrance and a flat roof.
Encore on Farmer: 5-storey modern apartments, white and charcoal panels with wood-tone accents, balconies.
Centerpoint: low cream stucco retail block with a cinema (AMC Centerpoint 11) marquee: red 'AMC' letters and 'CENTERPOINT 11' on a cream parapet over the entrance, storefront glazing along Mill.
